use_case_summary: Edge-to-cloud personalization: online model scores per user action, must return top-K in <50ms P95; requests short (8-40 tokens), high QPS bursts (hundreds to low thousands). Workload benefits from prefix/KV caching + micro-batching. Primary metrics: latency P95, token cost per 1M requests, and CTR lift stability.
model_preferences: Open LLM family (Llama-2 variants) preferred; willing to test Redwood-verified smaller LLMs. Strong preference for quantized 4-bit/integer paths with validation against live CTR metric.
latency_targets: P95 <= 50ms for single-shot rerank call; cold-start < 200ms; tail <100ms under 95th percentile traffic
throughput_targets: sustained 250 qps baseline, burst capacity to 2k qps for peak events; average request token length 16 tokens
cost_constraints: Targeting <$10k/month for inference at prototype scale; long-term target $0.0006 - $0.001 per token equivalent (including batching gains)
poc_details: POC harness: k6 + custom client that simulates mobile sessions (session affinity to test KV cache)
Benchmarks run: baseline hosted API (open endpoint), dedicated GPU pool (24A100 equiv), private VPC with limited egress
Key comparisons: no-batching single request latency vs small-batch (b=4-8) vs continuous batching; KV cache hit rates measured
Success criteria: P95 <50ms with >=85% cache hit; quantized model accuracy delta <1% CTR vs FP16 baseline
benchmark_requests: POC asks: 1) synthetic steady 250 qps test for 30m (token dist 8-20), 2) burst test 2k qps for 2m, 3) cold-start ramp from 0->200 qps in 30s, 4) A/B sample for quantization (same prompts, 10k examples)
